programme.title: The Bourne Legacy
programme.desc: Agent Aaron Cross must use his genetically-enhanced skills to finish what Jason Bourne started in this action-packed hit that takes the Bourne series to explosive new levels.

programme.title: Jason Bourne
programme.desc: It's been ten years since Jason Bourne walked away from the agency that trained him to become a deadly weapon. Hoping to draw him out of the shadows, CIA director Robert Dewey assigns hacker and counterinsurgency expert Heather Lee to find him. Lee suspects that former operative Nicky Parsons is also looking for him. As she begins tracking the duo, Bourne finds himself back in action battling a sinister network that utilizes terror and technology to maintain unchecked power.

programme.title: The Bourne Identity
programme.desc: An amnesiac is rescued at sea by the crew of an Italian fishing boat. Nearly dead, he carries nothing but the bullets in his back and the bank account number embedded in his hip. Although completely without identity or background, he possesses an array of extraordinary talents in fighting, linguistics and self-defence that speak of a dangerous past.

programme.title: The Bourne Supremacy
programme.desc: Jason Bourne is living in India when he is framed by Russian agent Kirill for the theft of millions from the CIA. Kirill begins to pursue Bourne, intending to assassinate him, but while Bourne and his girlfriend, Marie, are on the run, a shot meant for him kills her instead. Vowing revenge, Bourne sets out to prove his innocence and bring the culprits to justice, but he has to evade CIA head Pamela Landry, who is convinced he is guilty.

programme.title: See No Evil, Hear No Evil

programme.title: Big Daddy
programme.desc: A thirtysomething slacker attempts to inject some stability into his life by adopting an impressionable five-year-old.

programme.title: Police Academy
programme.desc: A group of good-hearted but incompetent misfits enter the police academy, but the instructors there are not going to put up with their pranks.

programme.title: Police Academy 2: Their First Assignment
programme.desc: Mahoney and friends have graduated from the Police Academy and are issued with their first assignments. As before, their cheerfulness and devotion to duty outweighs any shortcomings, but are they ready to do battle with a band of graffiti daubing terrorists?

programme.title: Police Academy 3: Back in Training
programme.desc: Slapstick farce with the incompetent cops as they set about saving their beloved academy from closure. Cutbacks mean that only one of the two police training schools can stay open, so Commandant Lassard appeals to the motley crew of graduates to come and train new recruits. However, the rival academy intends to sabotage their plans by cutting their training time down to a minimum.

programme.title: Planes, Trains and Automobiles
programme.desc: Fastidious businessman Neal Page and slobbish shower-curtain salesman Del Griffith are the reluctant odd couple trying to get home from New York to Chicago to be with their families at Thanksgiving. Their thwarted travel plans keep throwing them together.

programme.title: Tootsie
programme.desc: An out-of-work actor dresses in drag for an audition, only to land the female lead in a TV soap. When he becomes the most popular character on the show, he feels compelled to carry the persona into his everyday life. While bringing him phenomenal success as an `actress', life as a woman also has its problems - especially when he falls for an actress with whom he works.

programme.title: Risky Business
programme.desc: A normally well-behaved teenager goes wild while his parents are out of town. In charge at his parents' smart house, the 17-year-old sees the chance to make a fast buck when the prostitute, on the run from a scary pimp, appears at his door. He takes her in, and, following his school's entrepreneurial teachings, lets her turn the house into a brothel.

programme.title: The Cinema List: Epic Storytelling
programme.desc: This week's edition of the Cinema List is all about epic storytelling. From The Shawshank Redemption to Dunkirk, witness unforgettable tales of hope, courage and survival.

programme.title: The 'Burbs
programme.desc: An overstressed husband becomes obsessed with finding out the secret of his mysterious new neighbours. Concocting a series of increasingly outlandish schemes to discover the truth about the weird sounds he hears coming from the basement next door, the man settles on the theory that the family are a front for a cannibalistic cult.

programme.title: Dad's Army
programme.desc: In 1940, with a German invasion looming, the defence of Walmington-on-Sea is in the hands of local bank manager Captain Mainwaring and a motley collection of volunteers. After a series of blunders, the Home Guard finally gets the glory they deserve.

programme.title: Smokey and the Bandit
programme.desc: Tongue-in-cheek tale about a high-speed car chase across America involving a sheriff and a bootlegger with crash stunts galore. All goes well for the Bandit as he drives from Texas to Georgia with a truckload of illicit beer until he stops to pick up a damsel in distress, who also happens to be the sheriff's daughter.

programme.title: Blazing Saddles
programme.desc: Bart, a black railroad worker is appointed sheriff of a town marked for destruction by Hedley Lamarr, a scheming politician. As Lamarr tries to drive out the town's residents, Bart decides to stand in his way.

programme.title: The Witches of Eastwick
programme.desc: Three frustrated female divorcees living in a quiet town wish for the perfect man to enter their lives. Prior to joining CNN, Tapper served as senior White House correspondent at ABC News.

programme.title: Erin Burnett OutFront
programme.desc: It's Erin Burnett's turn to step out front and try to maintain a viable viewer presence for CNN in the weekday news arena. But the former CNBC anchor won't worry about ratings for her hourlong general news program, comparing that burden to "death." Instead, she'll concern herself with translating world events into relevant information for viewers, paying close attention to such topics as the Middle East and women's issues. "I want people to say that our show is smart. I want our show to be authentic", Burnett says in a promo. "I want our show to have courage". Left unsaid, of course, is that she wants her show to have a big audience, too.

programme.desc: The journey of an Indian dance troupe, a motley assortment of boys and girls who come from the backstreets of a Mumbai suburb, and their rise to fame, sudden downfall and heroic attempt to seek vindication by regaining their lost glory and pride.

programme.title: Kuch Kuch Hota Hai
programme.desc: After reading the letter her mother had written for her before she died, Anjali decides to bring together her widowed father, Rahul, with his true love who is also named Anjali.

programme.title: Jolly LLB 3
programme.desc: Advocates Jolly Mishra and Jolly Tyagi engage in a battle of wits in court, creating mayhem with their unexpected antics.

programme.title: Arjun Reddy
programme.desc: A brilliant medical student starts down a self-destructive path after his girlfriend is forced to marry another man.

programme.title: Patna Shukla
programme.desc: Tanvi Shukla, a Patna lower-court lawyer, pursues her childhood dream with determination, balancing professional ambition, ethical challenges, and personal growth along the legal journey.

programme.title: Action Replay
programme.desc: Fed-up with his parents constantly fighting, a young boy goes back in time to make his parents fall in love. This leads to hilarious situations.

programme.title: Ladies vs Ricky Bahl
programme.desc: A conman who earns his bread and butter by conning women ends up getting conned when a bunch of women team up to get revenge.

programme.title: Hungama
programme.desc: A trio in love triangle, a couple from the countryside, a disgruntled crime lord, and a myriad of other eccentric characters dance to a cacophony of reckless lies and misunderstandings.

programme.title: Rab Ne Bana Di Jodi
programme.desc: After the wedding ceremony between Surinder Sahni and Taani, Surinder discovers that his new wife cares little for him. When she decides to enter a dance competition, Surinder disguises himself, joins the class and tries to befriend her. Taani soon falls in love with her new dance partner, Raj, unaware that he is in fact her husband.

programme.title: Welcome Back
programme.desc: A pair of reformed gangsters try to find a husband for their newly discovered sister, but complications arise due to mistaken identities.

programme.title: A Thursday
programme.desc: In Mumbai, an ordinary Thursday takes a turn for the worse when some children end up as hostages of a schoolteacher struggling with deep-seated emotional scars.

programme.title: The Masterpiece
programme.desc: A portrait photographer tries to capture two key expressions from his girlfriend for a top contest, risking their relationship and his sanity in the process.

programme.title: Rekka
programme.desc: Adept at kidnapping unwilling brides and reuniting them with the men they genuinely love, a lawyer makes the potentially lethal mistake of abducting the fiancée of a local gangster.

programme.title: Deewana Mastana
programme.desc: Chaos ensues when a small-time crook and a mental patient tries to win heart of a beautiful woman with comical outcomes.

programme.title: Chandni Chowk to China
programme.desc: Sidhu is on the lowest rung of society, cutting vegetables in a roadside stall. programme.desc: A companion show to 'Strictly Come Dancing' that dives behind the scenes to give an all-access view, featuring all the backstage gossip from the dancing competition and drama from the rehearsal room.

programme.title: Escape to the Country
programme.desc: Jules Hudson is on home ground in the Welsh Borders as he showcases some tempting houses to a retired couple who have a whopping £1 million to spend. Along with a characterful property, they're after somewhere with holiday-let potential or space for a glamping business. Jules is also in his element when he meets experts in traditional construction methods who are keeping heritage building skills alive.

programme.title: Monty Don's British Gardens
programme.desc: Monty travels across the middle of the country, from Wales to Norfolk. He comes across gardens for gnomes, much-loved, well-tended allotments and extravagant gardens that bankrupted their owners.

programme.title: Rise of the Rockstar Chef
programme.desc: Marco Pierre White's meteoric rise opening Harvey's, and how the unpredictable young genius took fledgling Gordon Ramsay under his wing as a young Heston Blumenthal began his career.

programme.title: QI
programme.desc: Sandi Toksvig looks at some extra-large and extra-small topics. With Desiree Burch, Gyles Brandreth, Sheila Hancock and Alan Davies.

programme.title: Newsnight
programme.desc: Featuring extensive coverage of the day's top national and international news stories, along with explanations about the context and potential aftereffects.

programme.title: Highland Cops
programme.desc: Police uncover a huge cannabis haul in Inverness, search for a missing man in Glencoe, and face a siege after checking on a man believed to be in need of help.

programme.title: The Future with Hannah Fry
programme.desc: Bioacoustics technology and AI reveal how animals communicate, and may soon enable human-animal communication.

programme.title: Blue Lights
programme.desc: Life is in the balance after the explosion at Katie's house, while Gerry's evidence on state collusion is released. The section races to put an end to Morgan's empire.

programme.title: This Is BBC TWO
programme.desc: A preview of upcoming programmes from BBC Two.

programme.title: The Bidding Room
programme.desc: Toy seller Martin drives a hard bargain with the bidders, Debbie hopes her musical curio will strike a chord, and dealer Jo is bewitched by a painting with a mysterious history.

programme.title: House of Games
programme.desc: Every day this week, celebrity contestants Maisie Adam, Ade Edmondson, Rickie Haywood-Williams and Sammi Kinghorn take on a series of quiz rounds selected by the host, Michael Sheen. A daily winner is declared following a quickfire round at the end of each show, and the scores are tallied across the week, resulting in an overall champion being crowned on Friday. Will the winning stars opt for the much-coveted House of Games decanter, or will they be tempted with the House of Games record player?

programme.title: Mortimer and Whitehouse: Gone Fishing
programme.desc: Paul and Bob fish in Norfolk, hoping to catch a big bream. Bob throws a 70s-themed birthday party for Paul in a historic tower, and they both reminisce about Ted.

programme.title: The Future with Hannah Fry
programme.desc: Artificial intelligence has begun to exhibit early signs of agency. Hannah Fry discusses if AI has put humanity on a path to superintelligence or self-destruction, and if the potential promise and threat of AI is being exaggerated.

programme.title: BBC News
programme.desc: A comprehensive compilation of the latest and the most important news stories, updates and developments from the UK and different parts of the world.

programme.title: Political Thinking with Nick Robinson
programme.desc: Nick Robinson has a conversation with, not an interrogation of, the people who shape our political thinking about what shaped theirs.

programme.title: Lifeline
programme.desc: Kate Robbins presents this month's Lifeline appeal on behalf of PMRGCAuk, a charity providing support, information and advocacy for people affected by polymyalgia rheumatica and giant cell arteritis.

programme.title: Impossible
programme.desc: Contestants compete across the series, scoring points by answering questions correctly. However, they must avoid the impossible answers, otherwise they will be eliminated from the show until the next day.

programme.title: The Answer Run
programme.desc: Three couples face a series of 50/50 questions which hurtle The Answer Run down towards them. Across three rounds, the couples build up their cash pots, but only one pair can face The Final Run and win the chance to take home their cash prize.

programme.title: Coast to Coast Food Festival
programme.desc: Sean Fletcher explores the food market in Hay-on-Wye, getting tips on growing food and finding out the secret to making fudge. Chef Julie Lin discovers bargains in world food stores and supermarket aisles.

programme.title: Great Coastal Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo's Scottish railway journey reaches Aberdeen, from which he heads to the wild and beautiful Forvie National Nature Reserve and Scotland's most easterly town, Peterhead.

programme.title: Natural World
programme.desc: A bottlenose dolphin is about to be born in the treacherous waters of Shark Bay in Western Australia. Puck, the wise mother, must use all her skills to keep her newborn safe from the sharks that sweep into the bay every year. With the help of her close knit family of females she must teach the vulnerable baby dolphin the secrets of survival.
